entries.note: Tufesa's own line is REGISTRO DE ENVIO at the origin branch: the parcel checked in at the counter, as luggage is.
REGISTRO DE EMBARQUE: loaded on a coach at the origin branch.
REGISTRO DE TRAYECTO: recorded at a stop on the coach's route.
REGISTRO DE DESEMBARQUE: taken off the coach.

RECEPCION DE ENVIO EN CONTENEDOR at the destination branch, on shipments the recipient collects there (delivery type OCURRE). The adapter reads it as in transit on any other delivery type; the code alone does not say which, so the status map leaves it out.
ENTREGA DE ENVIO. A second EN line naming the receiver follows without wording; the page does not show it and the adapter drops it.
